description: Declaration-vs-static-use benchmark over 17 synthetic DSH-style plugin fixtures and 17 real code excerpts (14 workspace packages + 2 DSH docs examples).

fixtures.description: Pure arithmetic helpers with no imports and no ambient authority.
fixtures.notes: Baseline clean sample: no imports, no process access, no dynamic code.

fixtures.description: Static import of node:fs/promises; manifest declares filesystem.
fixtures.notes: Straightforward true positive: declaration matches a statically visible import.

fixtures.description: Static import of node:https; manifest declares network.
fixtures.notes: Network capability through a builtin module import.

fixtures.description: Spawns a child process while the manifest declares no capabilities.

toolFindings.message: Capability "process" is used in code (node:child_process) at src/index.js:1 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.

fixtures.notes: Ground truth says process is undeclared; the desired finding is undeclared=process.

fixtures.description: Reads process.env through dot and bracket notation; env is declared.
fixtures.notes: Both process.env and process["env"] must map to the same capability.

fixtures.description: Uses new Function and direct eval; eval is declared.
fixtures.notes: Language-level dynamic code evidence, not an import.

fixtures.description: Uses import("node:fs/promises") with a static string specifier.
fixtures.notes: Dynamic import with a string literal is in scope and should be detected (kind=dynamic).

fixtures.description: Builds the import specifier from concatenated strings; filesystem is actually used.
fixtures.notes: Deliberate false negative for a regex scanner. Because the manifest declares filesystem, the tool is expected to emit a false "unused" finding.
fixtures.limitation: Computed import specifier (MODULE_PREFIX + MODULE_NAME) is invisible to the regex scanner.

fixtures.description: Reaches the global eval function through a computed property name.

toolFindings.message: Capability "eval" is declared in dsh.capabilities but is not statically visible in the scanned files.

fixtures.notes: Deliberate false negative for a regex scanner. Because eval is declared, the tool is expected to emit a false "unused" finding.
fixtures.limitation: Computed global property access GLOBAL["ev" + "al"] is not matched by the eval(...) pattern.

fixtures.description: Comments contain imports, process.env and eval, but no executable capability.
fixtures.notes: Trap expected to pass: commented-out code and prose must not be reported.

fixtures.description: String and template literals contain import/require/process.env/eval text.
fixtures.notes: Trap expected to pass: literal samples in documentation strings must not be reported.

fixtures.description: Uses an eval-named object property, an evaluate() helper and a machine.env field.
fixtures.notes: Trap expected to pass: property access must not be treated as global eval or process.env.

fixtures.description: Imports node:path and a relative helper; neither grants an ambient capability.

toolFindings.message: Capability "unknown" is used in code (node:path) at src/index.js:1 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.

fixtures.notes: Expected false positive: capdiff maps every unmapped import (node:path, ./helper.js) to the fallback capability "unknown", which then appears as undeclared. "unknown" is explicitly not a real capability per the tool README.

fixtures.description: Manifest uses the object form of dsh.capabilities; filesystem is the only truthy entry.
fixtures.notes: Checks parseDeclared({ filesystem: true, network: false }) -> ["filesystem"].

fixtures.description: CommonJS file uses require("node:child_process"); process is declared.
fixtures.notes: Checks the .cjs extension and the require() extraction path.

fixtures.description: Declares filesystem but statically uses filesystem, network, process (re-export) and env.

toolFindings.message: Capability "env" is used in code (process.env) at src/index.js:7 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.
Capability "network" is used in code (node:https) at src/index.js:2 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.
Capability "process" is used in code (node:child_process) at src/index.js:4 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.

fixtures.notes: Recall test for undeclared findings: network, process and env should each be reported.

fixtures.description: Uses Node's global fetch() for network access.

toolFindings.message: Capability "network" is used in code (fetch()) at src/index.js:2 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.

fixtures.notes: Deliberate false negative: the README states that global fetch(...) calls are not scanned; only the import specifier "fetch" is mapped.
fixtures.limitation: Global fetch(url) has network capability but is not a module import and is not in the code-pattern list.

falsePositives.detail: Capability "eval" is declared in dsh.capabilities but is not statically visible in the scanned files.
Capability "unknown" is used in code (node:path) at src/index.js:1 but is not declared in dsh.capabilities.
not in the fixture's ground-truth actual set

falseNegatives.detail: Computed global property access GLOBAL["ev" + "al"] is not matched by the eval(...) pattern.

real.disclaimer: Real code excerpts, but a small hand-selected corpus. The excerpts are verbatim (trimmed at statement boundaries) except for two docs examples whose TypeScript annotations were stripped. The capability declarations in the fixture manifests are authored for the benchmark: the upstream packages do not declare dsh.capabilities. Rates describe this corpus only; a match is not a safety verdict.
